title: Freestanding Coat Rack 60-Inch Solid Brass | Polished Chrome | 8 Pivoting Pegs | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding Coat Rack With Eight Pivoting Pegs 60-Inch
description:
Stop piling coats and towels on counters—create an organized drop zone without drilling into walls in Polished Chrome, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures. This freestanding coat rack with eight pivoting pegs keeps items separated and easy to reach, making it a smart fit for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Polished Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stay steady on the floor: weighted base is designed to keep the rack stable to prevent tipping
- Protect finished floors: felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
- Coordinate your space: designed to pair with the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 60 x 10 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 26 x 26 x 12 in.
- Shipping weight: 18 lbs.
- Material: solid brass construction
- Assembly: some assembly required
